current_evidence: The council's Validation requirements page links only this PDF, the document states 'Adopted 3 November 2025', and a search found no later list (the review consultation was published 16 December 2024).

issues.detail: The workbook gives the List date as 2025-11-01, but the document says it was adopted on 3 November 2025. The workbook's own Date basis column already says 3 November.

Householder is recorded as '(none)', but several local requirements apply to householder applications. The Flood Risk and Resilience Statement covers householder development in Flood Zones 2, 3a and 3b. Tree Information covers trees with a TPO or in a conservation area, ancient woodland, veteran trees and Areas of Special Local Character. A Heritage Impact Assessment is needed for all development affecting heritage assets or their setting.
issues.evidence: Flood Risk and Resilience Statement: householder development, minor non-residential extensions under 250 sqm and minor alterations in Flood Zones 2, 3a or 3b

issues.detail: Many local requirements have no app_type row. (1) Building Height Information: new structures, except householder. (2) Economic Statement: net loss of employment floorspace in Main Employment Areas or Neighbourhood Centres, or non-business uses in the Manor Royal Main Employment Area. (3) Minerals Infrastructure Statement: within 250m of a Minerals Infrastructure Consultation Area. (4) Minerals Resource Assessment: Brick Clay Resource Consultation Area, sites of 3ha or more outside urban areas. (5) Waste Infrastructure Statement: on or within 250m of a waste site. (6) Noise Impact Assessment: major residential, noise-sensitive uses, and dwellings near the London-Brighton and Three Bridges-Horsham railways, major roads or aviation noise contours. (7) Public Art: all major applications, 1% of build costs. (8) Road Safety Audit: 20+ dwellings or 2,000 sqm+ commercial with access or highway works. (9) Statement of Community Involvement: where the developer has consulted, and mandatory for wind schemes of more than 2 turbines or a hub height over 15m. (10) Utilities Infrastructure Statement: major development, or a site without mains drainage. (11) Local BNG Statement / Urban Greening Factor: major and minor applications. (12) Planning Obligations Instruction Form (Appendix B): where a legal agreement is needed.
issues.evidence: Section 3 Local Requirements, e.g. Utilities Infrastructure Statement 'Required for major development or development on a site without mains drainage'

issues.detail: The Outline rows omit the Gatwick Green Strategic Employment Location outline pack. It requires an agreed masterplan, a mobility strategy, an Agricultural Land Classification Statement, a construction and phasing plan, air quality modelling and an impact assessment. The Master Plans and Design Codes threshold is also missing: significant development of more than 150 dwellings or 6,000 sqm commercial floorspace.
issues.evidence: Gatwick Green outline application pack; Master Plans and Design Codes

issues.detail: Some trigger excerpts belong to a different requirement. (a) The Viability Assessment row carries the Ventilation/Extraction trigger (E(b), E(g), B2, pubs, takeaways). The real trigger is any application that seeks to justify non-compliance with policy on viability grounds. (b) The Ventilation/Extraction row carries Air Quality / Emissions Mitigation Statement text. (c) The Energy/Sustainability Statement trigger stops mid-sentence and runs into Statement of Community Involvement text. The real triggers are over 100 sqm new build, one or more new dwellings, extensions to buildings of 1,000 sqm or more, and changes of use of 100 sqm or more. (d) The Planning Statement row quotes the Gypsy & Traveller H8 note. The real trigger is all major residential and commercial applications.
issues.evidence: Viability Assessment: 'Required where an application is seeking on grounds of financial viability to justify non-compliance' with policy

issues.detail: Several triggers are garbled fragments or incomplete. Air Quality stops after 'major development;' and omits AQMAs, B8 of 500 sqm or more, plant emissions and the 800m odour zone around Crawley STW. Flood Risk Assessment quotes only the Flood Zone 1 non-fluvial line. The main triggers are major development over 1ha in Flood Zone 1 and any development in Flood Zones 2 or 3. Drainage Strategy is garbled table text ('2-connections for all proposals for major to foul or development'). BNG mixes DAS and EIA text. Transport Assessment and Travel Plan give no thresholds; the source has separate TA thresholds (e.g. 80+ dwellings) and TS thresholds (50-80 dwellings). The Cycle parking and Parking rows read 'and motorcycle parking provision.' Site levels reads 'on changing ground levels.' Contaminated Land reads 'with the Land Contamination Risk Management Process (see web link).' Tree Survey gives no trigger. Retail/Town Centre omits the out-of-centre location and the 500 sqm retail / 2,500 sqm leisure thresholds.
issues.evidence: Air Quality: 'Major development; development in or likely to affect an AQMA; B8 of 500 sqm or more...'

issues.detail: 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' does not exist in the Crawley list. Its excerpt, and the excerpt for 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils', is a garbled run of reference links. The Agricultural Land Classification Statement is only part of the Gatwick Green outline pack, not a general Full planning requirement.
issues.evidence: Agricultural Land Classification Statement listed only within the Gatwick Green Strategic Employment Location pack

issues.detail: The Employment and Skills Plan, required for all major applications, is labelled 'Employment / Economic Statement'. That merges it with the separate Economic Statement for loss of employment floorspace. The Housing mix row quotes M4(2) text, but the source requirement is 'Floorplans (Proposed)' for one or more new dwellings showing Category 2 compliance. The Gypsy & Traveller row is shown as a requirement, but the source says it is not a strict validation requirement.
issues.evidence: Employment and Skills Plan vs Economic Statement are separate entries in Section 3

issues.detail: Environmental Statement (EIA) and Fire Statement are placed under Advertisement consent. That happened because the text 'Advertisement Applications' sat next to them in the PDF table. Neither applies to advertisement consent. Telecommunications supplementary information is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval', but it relates to telecoms prior approval and full applications, not change-of-use prior approvals.
issues.evidence: Trigger excerpt: 'Regulations 20172 Fire Statement Advertisement Applications Detailed Plan considers that an ES is required'

issues.detail: About 25 rows are marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. Many apply more widely or more narrowly than that. Tree Information, Flood Risk and Resilience and Heritage Impact Assessment also apply to householder schemes. The Block plan / Site plan excerpt comes from the Larger Home Extension (Class A4) prior approval requirement. The Archaeological Desk-based Assessment is placed under Listed building consent, but the source ties it to groundworks near heritage assets and Archaeological Notification Area thresholds, not to LBC.
issues.evidence: Block plan excerpt: 'a site plan ... must show the proposed development and any existing enlargement of the original house'

issues.detail: 'Measures to address water neutrality.' appears under 'Policy-driven requirements (all application types)'. In the source it is only a line in the Planning Obligations Instruction Form list of possible contributions. There is no Water Neutrality validation requirement. Several tab_items are fragments or process text, not requirements. Examples are 'be scaled to fit on an A4 size document; 8 Developer Contributions Guidance Note...', 'For further guidance see Community Infrastructure Levy General Guidance...' and 'The forms can be filled out and submitted online via the Planning Portal'. The 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' row ('established through pre-application engagement discussions') is not a requirement either.
issues.evidence: Water neutrality appears only in the Planning Obligations Instruction Form list: 'Measures to address water neutrality.'

issues.detail: Several rows are national requirements labelled as local: Design and Access Statement, Floor plans/Elevations, Roof plan and Block plan. The source marks the DAS as 'National Requirement'.
issues.evidence: 'National Requirement A Design and Access Statement must accompany...'

summary: Grokbot links the current Crawley list (adopted 3 November 2025), but the extraction is poor. Over a dozen local requirements are missing, including the householder Flood Risk and Resilience Statement. Several triggers are swapped between requirements or garbled, and EIA and Fire Statement are wrongly placed under Advertisement consent.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
